nodes.name: EU company with a VAT number?
Check the VAT number in VIES
nodes.notes: Integration 1: the EU VIES service (free, no key). If it does not answer, the order still goes through and a person checks the number.

parameters.query:
-- One customer per e-mail address (an existing customer is updated), then the order.
-- The price comes from the products table, never from the browser.
WITH customer AS (
  INSERT INTO customers (email, name, company, vat_number, vat_valid, vat_checked_at, country, address, source)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::boolean, CASE WHEN $5::boolean IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END, $6, $7, 'web')
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
    name           = EXCLUDED.name,
    company        = coalesce(EXCLUDED.company, customers.company),
    vat_number     = coalesce(EXCLUDED.vat_number, customers.vat_number),
    vat_valid      = coalesce(EXCLUDED.vat_valid, customers.vat_valid),
    vat_checked_at = coalesce(EXCLUDED.vat_checked_at, customers.vat_checked_at),
    country        = coalesce(EXCLUDED.country, customers.country),
    address        = coalesce(EXCLUDED.address, customers.address)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, ordered_on, product_code, course_id, course_slug, seats, price_excl,
                    promo_code, po_number, vat_rule, needs_review, review_reason, payload, source)
SELECT customer.id, current_date, p.code, co.id, $9, p.seats,
       CASE WHEN p.code = 'single' THEN coalesce(co.single_price, p.price_excl) ELSE p.price_excl END,
       $10, $11, $12, $13::boolean, $14, $15::jsonb, 'web'
FROM customer
JOIN products p ON p.code = $8 AND p.active
LEFT JOIN courses co ON co.slug = $9
RETURNING id AS order_id, product_code, price_excl,
          CASE WHEN product_code = 'single' THEN (SELECT title FROM courses WHERE slug = $9) END AS course_title;

-- The database hands out the number inside one transaction: no gaps, no duplicates.
-- Calling it again for the same order returns the same invoice.
SELECT id, number, customer_name, amount_excl, vat_rule, vat_amount, total, ogm, status,
       issued_on::text AS issued_on, due_on::text AS due_on
FROM create_invoice($1, $2, $3);
